t: You're looking at the grandstand and turnstiles of Fulham Football Club. It was designed by Archibald Leitch, a Scottish architect who is most famous for designing football stadiums throughout Great Britain and Ireland. Leitch's work is found at grounds across the country, so this is part of a much wider story of how football grounds took shape. There's little more recorded here, but the stand and its entrance are worth a moment as you pass.
